page: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor with an x86_64 architecture, it features 88 dedicated vCPUs across 44 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The server is equipped with 1536.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 17.45 GB per core. It includes a 410 GB local SSD and supports Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier capabilities in memory bandwidth, with uncached large-block read and write speeds ranking in the top 10%. Multi-core processing is highly efficient, as demonstrated by top-tier scores in Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and software compilation tests. Single-core performance is moderate, aligning with the middle 50% of tested systems. The processor's support for Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 accelerates vector and matrix operations, contributing to strong performance in LLM inference tasks for medium and large models.

From a resource density perspective, this server offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive memory footprints combined with dedicated compute resources. The absence of a GPU is a notable tradeoff, meaning parallelized graphics or GPU-bound deep learning tasks must rely on CPU-based execution. The system is highly suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure M176-88bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It features 88 dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C vCPUs running at 4.0 GHz, 1536.0 GB of RAM, and a 410 GB local SSD. The server delivers top-tier memory bandwidth and multi-core CPU performance, supported by advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 and Intel AMX. While single-core performance is average, its massive memory capacity and strong multi-threaded capabilities make it highly efficient for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, and heavy data processing.
